title: Christmas gifts for grandparents UK 2026: 10 they'll actually use
seoTitle: Christmas Gifts for Grandparents UK 2026: 10 Ideas
description: Christmas gifts for grandparents at UK Black Friday prices: Echo Show 8 £119.99, Kindle £119.99, Fire TV Stick 4K £31.99 and more, with setup tips.
intro:
**Our best Christmas gift for grandparents is the Amazon Echo Show 8 at £119.99, £80 off: easy video calls and a family photo frame in one. Best cheap pick: the Fire TV Stick 4K at £31.99. Best splurge: the Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at £139.99, its lowest price yet.**

Every price below was published on 21 or 22 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week (to 30 November), so check the product page before you buy. Some prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

deals.name: Amazon Echo Show 8
deals.note: Our best overall: an 8-inch screen for video calls with the grandchildren, a rotating album of family photos, the weather and radio, all by voice. £80 off (TechRadar, 21 November). Set it up and add your photos before you wrap it.

deals.name: Amazon Echo Show 5
deals.note: A smaller, cheaper screen that works as a bedside clock, radio and photo frame, and still does video calls. Pick this if they only want a clock and the news (TechRadar, 21 November).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: Our best splurge: text can be made as large as they like, the light adjusts itself, and it's waterproof. It charges on a wireless pad, so no fiddly cable. Its lowest price yet (TechRadar, 22 November).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (newest model, 16GB)
deals.note: The basic Kindle with a glare-free, adjustable-light screen and big-text options, at a record low. Light enough to hold in one hand for hours. Add a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) so it's full of books on Christmas Day.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K (latest model)
deals.note: Our best cheap pick: turns an older TV into a smart one, with a simple remote and voice search, so they can say 'play Gardeners' World' instead of hunting through menus. Lowest price yet, re-confirmed 22 November.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: Lets them see who's at the door from a phone or an Echo Show before opening it. Battery-powered, so no wiring. The 'was' adds two list prices together, but £40 for both is excellent (22 November). Saving clips needs a Ring subscription.

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: A gentle, quiet magnetic brush with a pressure sensor that lights up if they brush too hard. Under £50, about a third of its RRP (21 November).

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: A compact air fryer that cooks in glass dishes they can serve from and put straight in the fridge. A good size for one or two people, and cheaper to run than heating a full oven (21 November).

deals.name: LEGO Botanicals Orchid (608 pieces)
deals.note: A relaxing afternoon build that ends as a lifelike orchid for the windowsill, which never needs watering. Lovely to build together with a grandchild (TechRadar, 21 November).

deals.name: LEGO Botanicals Bonsai Tree
deals.note: The same idea as the orchid, with swappable green leaves or pink blossom. Close to Which?'s six-month low of about £30 (TechRadar, 21 November).

body:
## Best Christmas gifts for grandparents at a glance

- **Best overall:** Amazon Echo Show 8, £119.99 at Amazon
- **Best cheap:** Fire TV Stick 4K, £31.99 at Amazon
- **Best splurge:** Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition, £139.99 at Amazon
- **Best for keeping in touch:** Echo Show 5, £69.99 at Amazon
- **Best to build together:** LEGO Botanicals Orchid, £31.99 at Amazon

## How to choose a gift for grandparents

The best presents for grandparents usually do one of three things: help them keep in touch, make something they already do easier, or give them something to enjoy with the grandchildren. An Echo Show does the first brilliantly. Once it's set up, a video call is one spoken sentence ("Alexa, call Sarah"), and you can share a family photo album from your phone that plays on the screen all day. It's often the gift that gets used the most.

Be honest about how comfortable they are with technology. Anything that needs an app, a password or regular updates will need you to set it up first. The Echo Show, Fire TV Stick and Ring doorbell all work best if you unbox them, connect them to the Wi-Fi and sign them in before Christmas, then rewrap them. Write the Wi-Fi password on a card and leave it in the box, too.

For readers, a Kindle is a real quality-of-life upgrade: every book can be read in large print, the screen is easy on the eyes and it weighs less than a paperback. The basic Kindle is plenty; the Paperwhite Signature Edition adds an auto-adjusting light, waterproofing and wireless charging. If their eyesight makes reading tiring, an audiobook membership may be even better. Audible's Black Friday offer is £0.99 a month for three months for eligible members until 17 December, and you can gift a membership; see our [Audible free trial guide](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/).

Practical gifts are welcome too, as long as they feel like a treat rather than a hint. A quality electric toothbrush or a small air fryer for one or two people both fit. For warm, cosy presents, our [heated throw guide](/guides/heated-throw-deals-uk/) compares the best throws and what they cost to run. For more ideas, see our [Christmas gifts for Mum](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-mum-2026/), [Christmas gifts for Dad](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-dad-2026/) and all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## What's a good price this Christmas?

- **Echo Show 8:** £119.99 is £80 off; anything under £130 is good.
- **Kindle (2026):** £119.99 is a record low; it usually goes back to about £150.
- **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition:** £139.99 is its lowest price so far.
- **Fire TV Stick 4K:** under £35 is its best price.
- **Ring doorbell + indoor camera:** about £40 for both is excellent.

Most of these prices are part of Amazon's Black Friday Week, which ends on Cyber Monday, 30 November. Some need Prime; a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the sale and gives free fast delivery. Prices usually creep back up in December, so buying before 1 December is the safest bet.

## FAQs

### What do you buy grandparents who don't want anything?

Something that brings them closer to the family. An Echo Show loaded with family photos, a Lego Botanicals set to build with a grandchild, or a book on a Kindle you've already filled are all gifts that don't add clutter.

### Is an Echo Show easy for older people to use?

Yes, once it's set up. Almost everything works by voice, including video calls, the radio, timers and reminders. Do the setup yourself and add their contacts before Christmas Day.

### Which Kindle is best for older readers?

The basic Kindle is enough for most people, as all models let you make the text much larger. Choose the Paperwhite if they read in the bath or want a bigger screen and a light that adjusts itself.

### Can you gift an Audible membership?

Yes. Amazon lets you send an Audible membership as a gift, which is a good choice for someone who finds small print tiring. Their own free trial or the current Black Friday offer may be even better value.
